/disclaimer.lead: Please read this before acting on anything you see here.
sections: General information only, not veterinary advice

Pet Diet & Weight Tracker is operated by [TODO: legal name of operator / company], a founder based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. Everything on this website and in the app is general information. It is not veterinary advice, diagnosis or treatment, and using the service does not create a veterinarian-client-patient relationship with anyone.
This app is in beta

Pet Diet & Weight Tracker is a beta service. We always try to give the best information available, but it is still being built and tested, and it may be wrong, incomplete or change without notice. Please do not expect it to be right. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for decisions you make, or harm to a pet, from using it.
Everything here is experimental and an estimate

All nutrition data, growth charts and percentiles, calorie and portion suggestions, weight goals, "can my pet eat this" answers, food matches, scores, rankings and reviews are experimental. They are estimates produced by formulas, published datasets and third-party data. They may be incomplete, inaccurate, out of date or simply wrong for your pet.
Check before you act
Before you act on anything you read here, for any pet, verify it with at least one other reliable source and with your veterinarian. Always talk to your vet before you:
change your pet's diet or food,
start a weight-loss or weight-gain plan,
feed a growing puppy or kitten, or a pregnant, nursing, senior or sick pet differently,
give any new food, treat or supplement to a pet with a medical condition.
Emergencies
If your pet may have eaten something harmful, or seems unwell, do not wait and do not rely on this site. Contact your veterinarian, an emergency animal hospital or a pet poison helpline immediately.
Label and product data

Product details, guaranteed analyses, ingredients and calorie figures come from manufacturers, public databases (such as Open Pet Food Facts) and other third parties, or are typed in by users. Manufacturers change recipes and labels without notice. Always read the current label on the package you buy.
Reviews
Reviews are the personal opinions of the people who wrote them. They are not verified veterinary or scientific evidence and are not endorsed by us.
Sources
Where we cite organisations such as AAFCO, AAHA, WSAVA, the FDA or the ASPCA, we summarise their public material in our own words. They have not reviewed or endorsed this service.
Your responsibility
You are responsible for decisions you make about your pet. See our Terms and Conditions for the full terms, including limitation of liability and assumption of risk.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy.lead: What we collect, why, and how to delete it.
sections: Who is responsible

[TODO: legal name of operator / company], a founder based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, is responsible for personal information handled through Pet Diet & Weight Tracker. Contact: contact@choseno.com.
What we collect
We keep this short because we collect little:

Pet profile: your pet's name, species, breed or size group, birth date or age, sex, neuter status, weight, body condition, activity, allergies, health notes, goals, saved foods and weigh-ins (dates, weights, body condition scores).

Account: if you sign in with Google we receive your name and email address from Google; if you use email and password we store your email address and a hashed (not readable) password. Accounts are handled by our database provider (Supabase), and a sign-in token is stored on your device. You can use the foods, guides and tools pages without an account.
Reviews you choose to write: rating, text, how long you fed the food, the label you give your pet, and your pet's species, size group and approximate age.
Technical data that any web request involves, such as IP address, browser type and request time, processed by our hosting and database providers for security and operation.
Label photos: the service does not upload label photos. We will update this policy if that changes.
Local storage and cookies

We store your pet profile, saved foods and sign-in token in your browser's local storage (keys starting with "pnm.") so the app works offline and remembers you. We do not currently use advertising cookies or third-party analytics. We will update this section if that changes. Clearing your browser storage removes the local copy.
Why we use it, and legal bases
To provide the service: calculate growth, calories and food matches and save your profile (performance of a contract / necessary for the service you asked for).
To publish reviews you choose to submit, and to moderate them (consent and our legitimate interest in a trustworthy review section).
To keep the service secure, prevent abuse and fix problems (legitimate interests).
To meet legal obligations.
Under Canadian law (PIPEDA and BC PIPA) we rely on your consent, which you give by using the features described here; you may withdraw it at any time, subject to legal limits.
Sharing

We do not sell or rent personal information and do not share it for advertising. We share it only with service providers who process it for us under contract: Supabase (database and authentication) and our website hosting provider, Vercel. Published reviews are visible to everyone, without your name. We may disclose information if required by law or to protect rights and safety.
International transfers

Our providers may store and process data outside your country, including in the United States (our database is hosted in the US East region). Data stored abroad may be accessible to authorities under local law. Where GDPR or UK GDPR applies, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses offered by our providers.
How long we keep it

We keep your pet profile and weigh-ins until you delete them or your account, and we delete accounts that have been inactive for 24 months. Deleting your account also deletes your reviews. Backups are overwritten on our providers' normal cycles.
Your rights
Depending on where you live, you can ask to access, correct, delete or receive a copy of your personal information, object to or restrict some processing, and withdraw consent:

Canada (PIPEDA, BC PIPA): access and correction, withdrawal of consent, and complaints to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada or the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner for British Columbia.
EU/EEA and UK (GDPR, UK GDPR): access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection, and the right to complain to your local data protection authority.
California (CCPA/CPRA): the right to know, delete and correct, and to non-discrimination. We do not sell or share personal information for cross-context behavioural advertising.
To make a request, email contact@choseno.com. We may need to verify the request and will reply within the time the law requires.
How to delete your data

You can delete your account and all data linked to it yourself, in the app (Profile, then Delete my account and data) or on the website (Account, then Delete my data). Step-by-step instructions are on the Delete your account page at our website. You can also email us and we will delete it for you. Removing a single pet profile deletes that pet's weigh-ins, goals and diet items. Clearing your browser's site data removes the local copy.
Children

The service is meant for pet owners and is not directed at children under 13 (or under 16 in the EU/UK). We do not knowingly collect their personal information. If you believe a child has given us information, contact us and we will delete it.
Security

We use HTTPS, access controls in our database and providers with recognised security practices. No system is perfectly secure, so please avoid putting sensitive personal details in pet names, notes or reviews.
Changes
We will update this policy when our practices change and change the "Last updated" date above.
